note: On the Southwest Miramichi River at South Cains River near Blackville. The RV lots, about 50 ft by 100 ft, sit in mature forest 130-250 m back from the bank; an open field and the two cabins lie between them and the river, where campers can launch canoes and kayaks. Six tent sites. Some lots are let by the season. --Claude
summary: Keep, with a price question. Operator's site is live with online booking; 2027 daily rate is C$63 plus HST (was C$59), 30-amp full hookups on all 21 lots, season May 1 to late October. Google 4.8 (48). Rate, hookups, facilities, booking and season written; note rewritten.
flags: PRICE GATE (owner's call): 2027 daily rate C$63 plus HST. Before tax that is under the C$69 gate; with New Brunswick's 15% HST it is C$72.45, over it. No gateway within 40 km (gateways.py: 'none within 40 km; nearest: Kouchibouguac NP 67 km'); Good Sam: stored good_sam false; no operator member discount found on the pages read. Weekly C$375 plus HST works out to C$53.57 a night before tax. Not proposed as a drop; the gate's treatment of sales tax decides it.

Google: 4.8 from 48 reviews ('Nature's Nest RV Camping', 66 Cook Ln, Blackville; panel phone 506-850-2459, site naturesnestrvcamping.ca), read 2026-11-10. Phone 506-850-2459 confirmed on the operator's pages ('Call us: 506.850.2459'). No change.

WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE LEAD (not written; apply.py does not write waterfront): stored 'riverview'. Imagery (rendered, leaf-on) shows the RV loop in closed forest 130-250 m north of the bank, with a belt of trees and then an open field between the loop and the river; no lot has an open line to the water that the imagery can show. The operator claims only 'convenient access to the river' for campsites and puts the cabins 'along the river's edge'. Under the unsure-goes-down rule this reads 'not waterfront' unless a ground photo shows the river from a lot.

Long-stay tests: seasonal (C$2450) and monthly (C$975) rates exist and 'Seasonal sites have limited availability'; the policies page has lessee rules (decks need approval). The share of the 21 lots let seasonally is not published. Nightly booking is online and a Google review describes a one-night stay, so transient use is real. Share unknown: flagged, not a drop.
Season: opens 05-01 written with no closes value because the operator gives only 'the last weeks of October'. If apply.py or the map needs a closing date, the owner must choose one.
